description.text: Program Description When you apply for this program, you only need to fill out the department or school in the online application form. Students will choose their specific major offered by the department in the third year. This program is offered by the College of Economics. The College of Economics offers the following majors: Economics Finance International Economics & Trade Risk Management & Insurance Public Finance Environmental Resource & Economic Development Students are required to complete the curriculum in 4 to 6 years and fulfill the designated number of credits. Successful graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with the bachelor’s degree, according to the regulation of the Degree Committee. When to apply early January - early March Please visit the CUCAS website for the latest information. Applicants must come in person to Peking University to submit their application materials, unless applying through CUCAS, in which case application materials can be sent to CUCAS who will then submit them to the university on the student’s behalf. Entrance examination dates The written tests is early April. For the details of test venue and time, please refer to your Admission Card. The applicants who pass the written tests are required to attend an interview. Date and venue will be informed after the written tests. Entrance examination subjects Humanities/ Science: Chinese language Mathematics English Admission Admission will be determined according to the applicants' educational background, the results of the Entrance examinations and the interview. The admission result will be available in the end of May. The 'Letter of Admission' and the attached documents can be obtained by the end of June. Registration Period September (specified in the Letter of Admission)

duration.text: The Economics at Peking University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 300 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Additional materials Additional materials may be required

requirements.text: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport, above the age of 18 and under the age of 30, have attained a senior high school diploma.
